attempts.validity: logs COMPLETE, timings COMPLETE, handler max 1210.089 ms, failures 0

report.summary: Outbox publishing falls behind arrivals from ~18:00, so the pending backlog grows. The slow part is the consumer handler tail, not the DB or pool. Serial-delivery throughput is not directly confirmed.

findings.claim: Outbox publications dropped to ~7-8 per 10 s from ~18:00 while arrivals stayed at 30, so pending grew from ~3 to 158.
findings.reason: Per-bucket counts and pending samples show the gap opening mid-window; this matches late notifications.

findings.claim: Delivery latency has a slow tail located in the consumer handler (p95 ~1209 ms vs p50 0.024 ms); LedgerCore auth and overhead are normal.
findings.reason: Handler time accounts for the p95 total of ~1281 ms; auth is ~70 ms and unattributed time ~1 ms.

findings.claim: The slow handler likely caps outbox throughput, since polling is 1 s with 20-row batches. Publications of ~0.8/s are consistent with ~1.2 s per attempt delivered serially.
findings.reason: The timing fits, but serial delivery and per-time-bucket handler latency were not observed.

limitations: 138 FAILED rows and a ~890 s oldest-undelivered age predate the window. Delivery logs show only successes, so the cause of those failures is unexplained.
Handler latency was not broken down over time, so the link to the ~18:00 throughput drop is inferred. Delivery logs list only the first 100 of 517 attempts.
next_checks: Check consumer handler latency per time bucket, and the outbox dispatch concurrency and batching code, to confirm that serial slow deliveries cap throughput.
Inspect the 138 FAILED outbox rows (last error, attempts) and the pre-window logs to see why they failed and whether they block the queue.

alternatives.reason: Pool pending and active were 0, there were no acquisition timeouts and no blocking sessions were sampled.
alternatives.hypothesis: DB pool exhaustion or lock contention slowing the outbox

alternatives.reason: Transfer p99 was 0.25 s with no server errors; the delay is after commit, in the outbox.
alternatives.hypothesis: Request-path slowness on transfers causing the delay
